attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yegH`, a TerC family protein, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 13% of calls; the model names it in 99% of calls at 0.47 bits.

**Then 33 fork and variable columns open the window's most plastic stretch.** Columns 1 to 33 run in a region of plasticity in 44 to 93% of calls, and naming drops as low as 24% at column 1. Columns 1 to 21 are variable, 54 to 83% carried, the `wca` genes and `wzc`, `wzb`, `wza` among them, [[colanic acid biosynthesis]]; columns 23 to 33 are variable too, 7 to 39% carried, `rfbB` to `yegV`, [[sugar nucleotide biosynthesis]]. The model is most hesitant at column 23, `rfbB`, 2.13 bits, in a region of plasticity in 92% of calls.

**A spine follows, then small variable gaps.** Column 34, `gndA`, is persistent in 92% of chromosomes, named in 79% of calls. Columns 37 to 46 are spine, 90 to 91% carried, `hisIE` to `yeeZ`, [[histidine biosynthesis]], named in 82 to 94% of calls. Column 47 forks at `yeeY`, and column 50 is variable, `tnpA` at 2%.

**The last 28 columns are fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 26 to 72% of calls, named in 73 to 88%. Three parallel branches run through columns 60 to 62, 64 to 69 and 72 to 76, 14 to 15% carried, all shell: `pduT` to `pduQ`, `pduP` to a BMC domain-containing protein, and a diol dehydratase reactivase subunit to `pduB`, [[propanediol utilization]]. The window ends at column 79, `yeeN`, in 34% of chromosomes.

**Across the window the model names 78% of genes** at 0.81 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.09 against 0.40 bits, and names fewer genes, 68% against 91%.

label: yegH
facts:
WINDOW: the yegH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yegH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,656 to 1,735 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yegH once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 78% of genes, 0.81 bits on average (perplexity 2.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 15,416 calls, named 95%, 0.35 bits; shell 23,571 calls, named 77%, 0.84 bits; cloud 3,973 calls, named 14%, 2.41 bits. Outside an RGP 17,322 calls, named 91%, 0.40 bits; inside an RGP 25,638 calls, named 68%, 1.09 bits. Columns: 15 spine, 23 fork, 42 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.09 against 0.40 bits) and names fewer genes (68% against 91%); 25,638 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 23 (rfbB) 2.13 bits, RGP 92%; column 24 (rfbD) 1.87 bits, RGP 93%; column 27 (gatA) 1.62 bits, RGP 89%. The 54 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 73%, 0.92 bits on average; the other 26 columns: named 86%, 0.59 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-33 (fork and variable columns), RGP 44-93%; the least: columns 37-46 (spine), RGP 9-11%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 13%. Genes: yegH "TerC family protein". named 99%; 0.47 bits.
2. columns 1-33 (33 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 44-93%. named 24-95% (mean 70%), fewest named at column 1, named 24%; most hesitant at column 23, 2.13 bits.
   columns 1-21 variable, share 54-83%, all S: "hypothetical protein" 54%, wza 82%, wzb 83%, wzc 82%, wcaA 82%, wcaB "colanic acid biosynthesis acetyltra…" 82%, wcaC 82%, wcaD 81%, wcaE 81%, wcaF 81%, gmd 82%, fcl 81%, gmm 81%, wcaI 81%, cpsB 80%, cpsG "putative phosphomannomutase" 81%, wcaJ 81%, wzxC 82%, wcaK 81%, wcaL "colanic acid biosynthesis glycosylt…" 81%, wcaM 78%
   22 fork: galF P 90%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 31%, gne S 24%
   columns 23-33 variable, share 7-39%, 7 S, 4 P: rfbB 39%, rfbD 32%, rfbA "sugar phosphate nucleotidyltransfer…" 33%, rfbC 20%, gatA 7%, gatZ "class II D-tagatose-bisphosphate al…" 7%, gatY 7%, fbaB 8%, yegT "MFS transporter" 8%, yegU "ADP-ribosylglycohydrolase family pr…" 8%, yegV "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase" 8%
3. column 34 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 33%. Genes: gndA. named 79%; 0.63 bits.
4. columns 35-36 (2 columns) variable: RGP 15-24%. named 85-88% (mean 86%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35, named 85%, 0.57 bits.
   35: ugd P 90%
   36: wzzB S 76%
5. columns 37-46 (10 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 9-11%. Genes: hisIE, hisF "imidazole glycerol phosphate syntha…", hisA, hisH, hisB, hisC, hisD, hisG, hisL, yeeZ "NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase…". named 82-94% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 46 (yeeZ), named 82%, 0.50 bits.
6. column 47 fork: RGP 12%. named 84%; 0.49 bits.
   47: yeeY P 90% "LysR family transcriptional regulat…"; also yoeB S 63%
7. columns 48-49 (2 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 15-17%. Genes: yoeI "membrane protein YoeI", plaP. named 84-89% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 48 (yoeI), named 84%; most hesitant at column 49 (plaP), 0.51 bits.
8. column 50 variable: RGP 20%. named 89%; 0.52 bits.
   50: tnpA S 2%
9. column 51 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 24%. Genes: sbcB. named 87%; 0.69 bits.
10. columns 52-79 (28 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 26-72%. named 73-88% (mean 80%), fewest named at column 75, named 73%; most hesitant at column 59, 1.28 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 60-62, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15%, all S; the branch's families: pduT, "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing prot…", "1-propanol dehydrogenase PduQ"
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 64-69, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15%, all S; the branch's families: pduP, pduO, pduN, pduM, "PduL/EutD family phosphate acyltransfer…", "BMC domain-containing protein"
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 72-76, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 14-15%, all S; the branch's families: "diol dehydratase reactivase subunit alp…", pduE, "propanediol/glycerol family dehydratase…", pduC, pduB
